glyph_origin: Ideogrammic compound (會意): 𠂤 + 帀. 師 may be related to words denoting multitude, abundance, or movement to and fro, such as 詵, 駪, 甡, 莘, 侁, 瑟, 蝨 and 蟋.
s_page_origin: Simplified from 師 (𠂤 → 刂). Compare 帅 from 帥.
senses: [shī] (military) division; a large body of troops composing part of an army
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 師; s_page_origin explains the simplified 师.
